core_categories: Medical Monitoring Accessories; Cables; Sensors; OEM/ODM Manufacturing
specialty_focus: Shenzhen Medlink Electronics is a Chinese manufacturer specializing in medical monitoring accessories, cables, and sensors, including SpO2 sensors, ECG/EKG cables, temperature probes, NIBP cuffs, EEG/EMG sensors, and IBP transducers. It operates globally through distributors and OEM/ODM partners, supplying hospitals and regional medical device distributors. The company manufactures compatible and OEM replacement components for major monitoring equipment brands.
key_brands: Philips, GE Healthcare, Mindray, Medtronic, Nihon Kohden, Spacelabs, others
